title: LocVTP: Video-Text Pre-training for Temporal Localization

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: LocVTP: Video-Text Pre-training for Temporal Localization Video-Text Pre-training (VTP) aims to learn transferable representations for various downstream tasks from large-scale web videos.

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: To further enhance the temporal reasoning ability of the learned feature, we propose a context projection head and a temporal aware contrastive loss to perceive the contextual relationships.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Compared to the conventional separate pre-training on each single modality, e.g., video features are pre-trained under the action recognition datasets (Kinetics [23], Sport1M [22]), VTP has several advantages: 1) It leverages large-scale unlabeled narrated video data with automatically generated corresponding text data for video-text correspondence pre-training.
